design: Twenty documents, each rated across the seven strata by every rater. Ten are the corpus specimens (public or context tier: the document carries its own substrate). Ten are drawn from the private working-markdown block (corpus tier: the rater reads the document and may search the knowledge base it belongs to). Telos and substrate are stated per document, so a rater never infers the frame.
selection_rule: specimens: all ten. block-b: the first sampled id of every genre, plus the second sampled id of knowledge_patterns, tasks and emails.
